# README assets

Images used by the repository README.

- `logo-light.png` and `logo-dark.png`: the Open Media mark on a transparent background, for light and dark GitHub themes. Made from `assets/icon.png`.
- `hero.jpg`: the desktop and phone composite at the top of the README.
- `how-it-works.svg`: the "How it works" diagram.
- `film/`: the Open Media film and the README's preview loop (see `film/README.md`).
- `screenshots/`: framed screenshots of the running app.

Notes for agents: capture screenshots from the real app (`npm run local`) at 2x or 3x scale, show only public posts or local test data, and never include real messages, email or account details.
